fix.summary: Replace static admin cookie with random server-side session issued only on valid login and validated on /admin.
fix.risk: Admin sessions are in-memory only and reset on restart; older Node without global crypto would fail login.

applied.find: if (p.user === 'admin' && p.password === 'maisonverde2019') return [302, { location: '/admin', 'set-cookie': 'session=admin-7c9e; Path=/' }, '']; // FLAW 8 (cookie): no HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite
applied.replace: if (p.user === 'admin' && p.password === 'maisonverde2019') { const t = crypto.randomUUID(); sessions.add(t); return [302, { location: '/admin', 'set-cookie': 'session=' + t + '; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax' }, '']; }
{ const m = /session=([^;\s]+)/.exec(headers.cookie || ''); if (m && sessions.has(m[1])) return html(page('admin.html')); }
